role: Turns climate classes into real biome ids: warm, medium, cold and icy tables, with the special flag giving mesa plateaus, jungle or mega taiga.
scope_reason: Part of the overworld biome layer stack (GenLayer.initializeAllBiomeGenerators) that decides the biome of every overworld column.

members.name: field_151623_c
members.note: static const int warm[] inside biome().

members.name: GenLayerBiome
members.note: Only WorldType.DEFAULT; the DEFAULT_1_1 warm table swap is not ported (the game only makes default worlds).

notes: The DEFAULT_1_1 branch is unreachable for this game's world type, so it is not counted as missing. layers.c builds the stack as a pointer graph of struct layer nodes (p1, p2) in a fixed 64-node array and recurses through it, and each layer mallocs its parent area per call (area()); both are GPU-contract hazards but outside the tick (chunk generation). Status exact rests on test_worldgen comparing the genbiomes and biomes stages against the oracle chunk dumps; the gate was not re-run for this record.
